How it works

Pick it, connect it, share it.
Live in a minute.

  1. 01

    Use the form template

    It opens in Claritia ready to go, in the style you picked. Answers are linked to your contact fields and the form goes live.

  2. 02

    Connect your tools

    Send answers to HubSpot, Salesforce or Omniscient, open your calendar after a booking form, and tell your team in Slack.

  3. 03

    Share it anywhere

    Send the link, or add one line to Webflow, WordPress, Framer or any page. Every answer lands as a contact.

Questions

Something else? hello@tryclaritia.com

Are the form templates free?

Yes. Every form template is free on every plan, including the free one.

Can I change a form template?

Yes. Change any question, its wording and options, the order, the style and the thank-you screen. Tailor can rewrite the wording for your business from one sentence.

Can I match my brand?

Pick one of 18 styles, then set your own button color. Every style works on phones and with a keyboard.

Where do the answers go?

Each answer is saved in Claritia. It can sync to HubSpot, Salesforce or Omniscient.

How do I add a form to my website?

Share the link, or paste one line of code where the form should show. It fits Webflow, WordPress, Framer and plain HTML.

Do the forms ask for consent?

Yes. An opt-in box in the EU, the UK and other strict regions, and a short notice elsewhere. The exact words each person saw are saved.
